scope: Current model-independent score semantics for the supported benchmark catalog
layer_definition: Given the same final answer, patch, or task artifact, Loom assigns the declared canonical task reward and aggregate metric semantics.

canonical_reference.title: AIME 2024 rows from AI-MO/aimo-validation-aime
canonical_reference.justification: AIME 2024 uses exact normalized integer matching.

harbor_support.parity_target: Harbor adapters/aime at the pinned commit
harbor_support.decision: Compare identical final answers against both exact-integer verifier paths.

score_semantics.denominator: number of runnable aime-24 task ids
score_semantics.task_reward: 1.0 when the normalized final integer equals the canonical integer; 0.0 otherwise
score_semantics.aggregation: arithmetic mean over distinct task ids

cases.reference: canonical answer integer from task metadata
cases.replay_method: Replay a known correct integer through Loom and Harbor's AIME verifier.

harbor_support.parity_target: Harbor adapters/aime at the pinned commit

score_semantics.task_reward: 1.0 when the normalized final integer equals the canonical integer; 0.0 otherwise

canonical_reference.title: GPQA Extended
canonical_reference.justification: Loom imports the Extended subset and scores exact answer choices.

harbor_support.decision: Harbor's gpqa-diamond adapter uses a different subset, so it is not a matched GPQA Extended reference.

score_semantics.task_set: GPQA Extended test rows in gpqa
score_semantics.denominator: number of runnable gpqa task ids
score_semantics.task_reward: 1.0 when the normalized selected choice matches the canonical answer; 0.0 otherwise
score_semantics.aggregation: arithmetic mean over distinct task ids

cases.replay_method: Replay a known correct choice through Loom and the upstream answer-key scorer.

canonical_reference.title: MATH-500
canonical_reference.justification: MATH-500 uses canonical normalized final-answer equivalence.

harbor_support.decision: Use the upstream scorer because the pinned Harbor tree has no matching MATH-500 adapter.

score_semantics.denominator: number of runnable math-500 task ids
score_semantics.task_reward: 1.0 when the normalized final answer is equivalent to the canonical answer; 0.0 otherwise
score_semantics.aggregation: arithmetic mean over distinct task ids

cases.replay_method: Replay a known equivalent answer through Loom and the canonical scorer.

canonical_reference.title: OpenAI HumanEval
canonical_reference.justification: HumanEval is scored by executing the canonical tests.

harbor_support.decision: Use the canonical harness because Harbor's humanevalfix adapter is not the same benchmark contract.

score_semantics.task_set: OpenAI HumanEval test tasks in humaneval
score_semantics.denominator: number of runnable humaneval task ids
score_semantics.aggregation: arithmetic mean over distinct task ids for pass@1

cases.replay_method: Execute a known passing solution through Loom and the canonical harness.

canonical_reference.title: LiveCodeBench code generation lite
canonical_reference.justification: LiveCodeBench code-generation tasks use the pinned upstream evaluator.

harbor_support.parity_target: Harbor adapters/livecodebench at the pinned commit
harbor_support.decision: Replay identical programs through Loom and Harbor's pinned LiveCodeBench evaluator.

score_semantics.denominator: number of runnable livecodebench task ids
score_semantics.task_reward: 1.0 when the program passes canonical tests; 0.0 otherwise
score_semantics.aggregation: arithmetic mean over distinct task ids

cases.replay_method: Execute a known passing program through Loom and the pinned upstream evaluator.

canonical_reference.title: Google MBPP sanitized
canonical_reference.justification: MBPP sanitized is scored by executing its canonical tests.

harbor_support.decision: Use the canonical tests because the pinned Harbor tree has no matching MBPP adapter.

score_semantics.task_set: sanitized MBPP test rows in mbpp
score_semantics.denominator: number of runnable mbpp task ids
score_semantics.aggregation: arithmetic mean over distinct task ids for pass@1

cases.replay_method: Execute a known passing solution through Loom and the canonical tests.

canonical_reference.title: TIGER-Lab MMLU-Pro
canonical_reference.justification: MMLU-Pro is scored by exact normalized answer choice.

harbor_support.decision: Use the upstream scorer because Harbor's mmmlu adapter is not MMLU-Pro.

score_semantics.task_set: TIGER-Lab MMLU-Pro test rows in mmlu-pro
score_semantics.denominator: number of runnable mmlu-pro task ids
score_semantics.task_reward: 1.0 when the normalized selected option equals the canonical answer; 0.0 otherwise
score_semantics.aggregation: arithmetic mean over distinct task ids

cases.replay_method: Replay a known correct choice through Loom and the upstream answer-key scorer.

canonical_reference.title: SkillFlow task bundle
canonical_reference.justification: SkillFlow rewards come from each upstream-compatible task verifier.

harbor_support.decision: Use the task's verifier because the pinned Harbor tree has no SkillFlow adapter.

score_semantics.denominator: number of runnable skillflow task ids
score_semantics.task_reward: finite numeric reward emitted by the upstream-compatible task verifier
score_semantics.aggregation: arithmetic mean over distinct task ids
score_semantics.partial_credit: preserved when the task verifier emits a fractional reward

cases.replay_method: Replay a known successful artifact through Loom and the task verifier.

score_semantics.denominator: number of runnable skilllearnbench task ids
score_semantics.task_reward: finite numeric reward emitted by the upstream-compatible task verifier

canonical_reference.title: SWE-Bench Verified
canonical_reference.justification: SWE-Bench Verified is scored by the official instance tests.

harbor_support.parity_target: Harbor adapters/swebench at the pinned commit
harbor_support.decision: Replay identical patches through Loom and Harbor or the official SWE-Bench harness.

score_semantics.task_set: SWE-Bench Verified test instances in swe-bench-verified
score_semantics.denominator: number of runnable swe-bench-verified task ids
score_semantics.task_reward: 1.0 when the patch resolves the instance according to canonical tests; 0.0 otherwise
score_semantics.aggregation: arithmetic mean over distinct task ids

cases.replay_method: Replay a known resolving patch through Loom and the official or Harbor verifier.

canonical_reference.title: Terminal-Bench 2.1 Harbor Hub revision 6 physical profile
canonical_reference.justification: The physical profile contains 89 locked packages with native verifiers.

harbor_support.parity_target: Locked Harbor Hub revision-6 native verifier
harbor_support.decision: Preserve and run each package's native tests/test.sh in a fresh verifier driver.

score_semantics.task_reward: finite native numeric reward, including 0; missing, malformed, non-finite, or timed-out evidence is a verifier failure
score_semantics.aggregation: arithmetic mean over all 89 tasks after platform failures are resolved
score_semantics.partial_credit: preserved exactly when the native verifier emits a fractional reward

cases.reference: locked Harbor Hub revision-6 verifier output
cases.replay_method: Replay a known successful artifact through native tests/test.sh in a fresh verifier driver.
